# Saving for a Bow

*Fionn is saving for a bow and needs fox sinew for its string. Go out to the last stump on the Forest Shore, defeat 50 Strand Foxes on the Strandwood Rocks and bring him 12 Fox Sinews. Not a word to Hamish.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Goa Harbour](../towns/goa_harbour_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Fionn](../npcs/fionn_child.md) |
| Level | 26 |
| After | [Fionn's Shortcuts](../quests/fionn_the_shortcuts.md) |

## Objectives

1. Reach the last stump in [Gull Heath](../maps/gull_heath.md)
2. Defeat 50 [Strand Fox](../monsters/strand_fox.md) in [Strandwood Rocks](../maps/strandwood_rocks.md)
3. Bring 12 [Fox Sinew](../items/fox_sinew.md) (taken)

## Rewards

- 3,800 EXP
- 1,000 mesos
- [Brodie's Smoked Fish](../items/brodies_smoked_fish.md) x10
- +20 standing with Goa Harbour
- +150 standing with [Fionn](../npcs/fionn_child.md)
